login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Hazard and near-miss reporting for Plant X
login.noBlame: Reporting is no-blame. Your report goes only to your area supervisor and the EHS team.

capture.speakHint: Tap to start, tap again to stop
capture.needArea: Scan or choose the area first
capture.needContent: Add a photo, your voice or a description
capture.micDenied: Microphone permission is off. You can type instead.

scan.title: Scan area QR
scan.hint: Point the camera at the QR sign at the area entrance
scan.unknown: This QR code is not a Plant X area

review.title: Review
review.transcriptLabel: What you said (you can fix it)
review.placeholder: What is the hazard and where exactly?
review.transcribeFailed: Could not turn voice into text. Please type a short description — your recording is still attached.
review.savedOffline: Saved on this phone — it will send when you are back online.
review.aiNote: AI turns speech into text and suggests a category. A supervisor checks every report.

submitted.title: Report sent
submitted.track: You can track this in My Reports
submitted.unclassified: A supervisor will sort this report

reports.title: My Reports
reports.empty: No reports yet. Your reports will appear here.
reports.thanks: Thank you. Your report made this area safer.
reports.notYet: Your supervisor has it. You will see the fix here when it is done.

induction.title: Contractor check-in
induction.intro: Three quick safety questions before your first shift at Plant X.
induction.q1: You smell gas near a tank. What do you do first?
induction.q1a: Move away upwind and report it
induction.q2: Where must you wear a helmet?
induction.q3: Who can see the hazard reports you send?
induction.q3b: Your area supervisor and the EHS team
